p: At the close of the middle blessing
of the Shemoneh Esreh and Kiddush HaYom
we say, "And Your word, our King,
וְהוּא עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר (תְּהִלִּים קיט, פט)
This is based on what is said (Tehillim 119:89),
"Forever, Hashem, Your word stands firm in the heavens,"
"By the word of Hashem the heavens were made,"
וְהוּא עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁכָּתְבוּ תּוֹסָפוֹת
It is based on what Tosafos wrote
(רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה כז, א דִּבּוּר הַמַּתְחִיל כְּמַאן)
on the dispute of Rabbi Eliezer and Rabbi Yehoshua,
that both are the words of the living G-d:
in Tishrei it arose in thought to create,
but it was not created until Nissan;
and so writes the Pri Etz Chaim
This is why we say on Rosh Hashanah,
for it is according to the thought.
it arose to create with the attribute of judgment;
that there would be the corruption
and it would not endure with the attribute of judgment,
He therefore joined to it the attribute of mercy
And every Rosh Hashanah is the time
"In Tishrei they are destined to be redeemed":
that is, that it will be according to the thought;
and in the manner of what it says (Yeshayahu 66:22),
"Of all the Mussafim it is written, 'You shall offer,'
but here it is written, 'You shall make,'" etc.:
And the opening of the blessing,
"Reign over the whole world in Your glory" —
for the essential purpose of Creation
the glory of His kingship be revealed,
כָּל מַה שֶּׁבָּרָא הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
"Everything that the Holy One, blessed be He, created,
He created only for His glory," etc.
"And be exalted over all the earth in Your splendor":
That is, that it be revealed
that is, that there will shine like day
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג רצ, א)
And this is why we say "in Your splendor":
(בְּמִדְבַּר רַבָּה יט, ו; תַּנְחוּמָא חֻקַּת ח)
כָּל יְקָר רָאֲתָה עֵינוֹ (אִיּוֹב כח, י)
this is Rabbi Akiva and his colleagues."
"Things that were not revealed to Moshe
were revealed to Rabbi Akiva and his colleagues."
"And by knowledge the chambers are filled
with all precious and pleasant wealth"
This is why it says, "And let every creature know
עַל דֶּרֶךְ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (בְּמִדְבַּר רַבָּה י, א)
in the manner of what they said (Bamidbar Rabbah 10:1):
"'And knowledge' — this is one who recognizes his Creator."
וְיָבִין כָּל יְצוּר כִּי אַתָּה יְצַרְתּוֹ —
"And let every formed being understand that You formed it" —
that is, that the fear should enter
into the depths of the heart,
"Then you will understand the fear of Hashem
and find the knowledge of G-d";
that is, to "Binah is the heart,"
that you understand in the depths of the heart —
then "knowledge will be pleasant to your soul":
this is the Daas that is
And it corresponds to what is said,
"And be exalted over all the earth in Your splendor."
וְעַל יְדֵי כָּךְ יֵדַע כָּל פָּעוּל
And through this "every creature will know
and every formed being understand," etc.
And we conclude, "And Your word, our King,
which is according to the thought,
and "by the word of Hashem the heavens were made,"
and it will be that "truthful speech shall be established forever."
